notes: FreeLLMAPI — a fourth AI provider. Adds a self-hosted free-provider gateway (MIT, github.com/tashfeenahmed/freellmapi) alongside DeepSeek, Claude Code and Antigravity — as a provider, not a new coding agent. Claude Code connects through FreeLLMAPI's Anthropic Messages surface (/v1/messages); DeepSeek Harness and Sidekick connect through the OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions endpoint. Pick a model (default 'auto'), set your server URL and unified token (stored in the encrypted ApiKeyVault). Experimental · Personal use · Upstream provider terms apply. This APK is SIGNED (V2).
